hook.name: NasdankFeeHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook that charges a fixed WETH fee (in pips) on every swap through registered pools, taking fees on both the specified and unspecified WETH leg via beforeSwap/afterSwap return-delta accounting. Fees accrue per-pool and are distributed to immutable project and protocol treasuries via a permissionless claim() function.
